read.comment: status reports only whether a key is PRESENT, never its value or length; security_status reports facts about the owner's PIN and phone (is one set, is one enrolled), never a PIN, a secret or a QR

write.comment: set_secret writes a key into a root-only file; there is no matching read, by design. set_pin and enrol_start take a PIN and return a phone's secret and QR, once, to the call that asked; they are write-only for the same reason
